'''Shioya Shrine''' (塩屋神社) is a shrine located in {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|en|Hiroshima Prefecture|qid=Q617375|lt=Hiroshima Prefecture}} {{ill|Hiroshima|en|Hiroshima|qid=Q34664|lt=Hiroshima City}} {{ill|Saeki-ku, Hiroshima|en|Saeki-ku, Hiroshima|qid=Q73718|lt=Saeki Ward}} {{ill|Ebiyama Town|ja|海老山町 (広島市)|lt=Ebiyama Town|lt_ja=海老山町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ebiyama Town (Hiroshima)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q42633835}}.

== Overview ==
Within the shrine grounds stands the '''Daikei Tree''' of {{ill|Zelkova serrata|en|Zelkova serrata|qid=Q920344|lt=Zelkova}}.

Beside it, an upright sign bears the inscription: {{Quote|The branches resemble an OK sign formed as if an index finger were raised.<br>It appears that wishes may be granted.|Shioya Shrine|Shioya Shrine grounds}}

== History ==
* Around the 26th year of {{ill|Empress Suiko|en|Empress Suiko|qid=Q298057|lt=Empress Suiko}} ({{ill|618|en|618|qid=Q31035|lt=618 AD}}): Shioya Shrine is said to have been established.
* In {{ill|Heisei era|en|Heisei era|qid=Q234510|lt=Heisei}} 28 ({{ill|2015|en|2015|qid=Q2002|lt=2015 AD}}): Renovations were carried out on the grounds as part of the 1400th-anniversary commemoration of its enshrinement.
* In Heisei 30 ({{ill|2018|en|2018|qid=Q25291|lt=2018 AD}}): The 1400th anniversary of the shrine’s enshrinement was observed.

== Annual Festival ==
Held in conjunction with the Tanabata festival.
* Passing through the straw ring
* Grand Festival
* Dedication of the Kawahara Tsukagura Group (Not currently dedicated as of Reiwa 7)

'''Shioya Shrine''' (塩屋神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Q20038243|ja|海老山町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ebiyama Town, Hiroshima|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q20038243}}, {{ill|Saeki-ku, Hiroshima|en|Saeki-ku, Hiroshima|qid=Q73718|lt=Saeki-ku, Hiroshima}}, {{ill|Hiroshima|en|Hiroshima|qid=Q34664|lt=Hiroshima City}}, {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|en|Hiroshima Prefecture|qid=Q617375|lt=広島県}}.

== Overview ==
The shrine grounds feature a large [[zelkova tree]] known as the '''Daikei Tree'''. 

A sign on the premises reads: 
{{Quote|The branches resemble the shape of "OK" with fingers pointing upwards. It seems like a place where your wishes may come true.|Shioya Shrine|Shioya Shrine grounds}}

== History ==
* {{ill|Empress Suiko|en|Empress Suiko|qid=Q298057|lt=Suiko}} 26 (618 CE): Traditionally believed to be the year of the shrine's establishment.
* [[:en:Heisei period|Heisei]] 28 (2015 CE): Grounds renovation as part of the 1,400th anniversary commemoration.
* Heisei 30 (2018 CE): 1,400th anniversary of the shrine's foundation.

== festival ==
The shrine festival coincides with Tanabata traditions, including:
* Chinowa Kuguri (Passing through the grass ring)
* Main Festival and Shrine Maiden’s Purification Rites
* Kaguradan dedication by the Kawarazu Kagura Troupe
